passing_property:
// td_mode matches the RTL case mapping of ctrl[7:5].
    check_td_mode_mapping: assert property (
        @(posedge clk)
        td_mode == ((ctrl[7:5] == 3'b000) ? 4'b0000 :
                    (ctrl[7:5] == 3'b001) ? 4'b1000 :
                    (ctrl[7:5] == 3'b010) ? 4'b0100 :
                    (ctrl[7:5] == 3'b011) ? 4'b1100 :
                    (ctrl[7:5] == 3'b100) ? 4'b0010 :
                    (ctrl[7:5] == 3'b101) ? 4'b1010 :
                    (ctrl[7:5] == 3'b110) ? 4'b0101 :
                                             4'b1111)
    );

// Any unmapped ctrl[7:5] value selects 1111.
    check_default_maps_to_1111: assert property (
        @(posedge clk)
        ((ctrl[7:5] != 3'b000) &&
         (ctrl[7:5] != 3'b001) &&
         (ctrl[7:5] != 3'b010) &&
         (ctrl[7:5] != 3'b011) &&
         (ctrl[7:5] != 3'b100) &&
         (ctrl[7:5] != 3'b101) &&
         (ctrl[7:5] != 3'b110)) |-> (td_mode == 4'b1111)
    );

// Flush clears all outputs on the next cycle.
    check_flush_clears_outputs: assert property (
        @(posedge Clk) flush |=> (
            (OverflowEn_out == 1'b0) &&
            (Branch_addr_out == 32'b0) &&
            (PC_add_out == 32'b0) &&
            (Condition_out == 3'b0) &&
            (Branch_out == 1'b0) &&
            (PC_write_out == 3'b0) &&
            (Mem_Byte_Write_out == 4'b0) &&
            (Rd_Write_Byte_en_out == 5'b0) &&
            (MemWBSrc_out == 1'b0) &&
            (MemData_out == 32'h0) &&
            (WBData_out == 32'b0) &&
            (Less_out == 1'b0) &&
            (Zero_out == 1'b0) &&
            (Overflow_out == 1'b0) &&
            (Rd_out == 5'b0)
        )
    );

// When stalled, outputs hold their previous values.
    check_hold_when_stalled: assert property (
        @(posedge Clk) disable iff (flush) stall |=> (
            (OverflowEn_out == $past(OverflowEn_out)) &&
            (Branch_addr_out == $past(Branch_addr_out)) &&
            (PC_add_out == $past(PC_add_out)) &&
            (Condition_out == $past(Condition_out)) &&
            (Branch_out == $past(Branch_out)) &&
            (PC_write_out == $past(PC_write_out)) &&
            (Mem_Byte_Write_out == $past(Mem_Byte_Write_out)) &&
            (Rd_Write_Byte_en_out == $past(Rd_Write_Byte_en_out)) &&
            (MemWBSrc_out == $past(MemWBSrc_out)) &&
            (MemData_out == $past(MemData_out)) &&
            (WBData_out == $past(WBData_out)) &&
            (Less_out == $past(Less_out)) &&
            (Zero_out == $past(Zero_out)) &&
            (Overflow_out == $past(Overflow_out)) &&
            (Rd_out == $past(Rd_out))
        )
    );

// X matches the RTL sum-of-products equation.
    check_x_matches_rtl_equation: assert property (
        @(posedge clk)
        X == ((A1 & A2 & A3) |
              (A1 & A2 & A4) |
              (A1 & A3 & A4) |
              (A2 & A3 & A4) |
              (A1 & A2 & B1) |
              (A1 & A3 & B1) |
              (A1 & A4 & B1) |
              (A2 & A3 & B1) |
              (A2 & A4 & B1) |
              (A3 & A4 & B1))
    );

// With no asserted product term, X must be low.
    check_no_triplet_or_pair_means_x_low: assert property (
        @(posedge clk)
        !((A1 & A2 & A3) |
          (A1 & A2 & A4) |
          (A1 & A3 & A4) |
          (A2 & A3 & A4) |
          (A1 & A2 & B1) |
          (A1 & A3 & B1) |
          (A1 & A4 & B1) |
          (A2 & A3 & B1) |
          (A2 & A4 & B1) |
          (A3 & A4 & B1)) |-> !X
    );
